title: Do you think that’s a good idea?
html_source: These modest proposals of Bloom contrast with the more brash characters about to appear. Also, it serves to set Bloom apart from the press men in this chapter as Odysseus was set apart from his crew in Book X of the Odyssey. The crew believe Aeolus has given Odysseus a bag of riches , open the bag when he’s asleep and unwittingly release the storms which ruin their return to Ithaca. Odysseus modestly blames himself for their acts, explaining to Aeolus that he fell asleep.
